description: $0.005 USDC. Pay-To Safety Check. Send a URL, an EVM address, or both, plus an optional expected price and network. Returns safe, caution, or avoid with reasons and a score. Compares live 402 terms with Coinbase Bazaar prices, checks RDAP domain age, screens the OFAC SDN address list, and sees whether the payTo is a contract or an EOA. A failed source is reported and is not treated as a clean bill of health.
name: pay_to_check
title: Pay-To Safety Check
